```plato

//==
// # Series in classical bases
//
// Truncated series: each stores the coefficients of finitely many basis
// terms, ascending by term index.

// A truncated power series about Center: the sum of Coefficients[k] times
// (x - Center)^k (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_series).
type PowerSeries
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Number;
    Coefficients: Array<Number>;
}
```
